messages:
anna_marketing: Heads up — inbound assignment latency spiked over the last 3h, median assign time ~22m and ~14% of leads remained unassigned. Dashboard: https://app.redwood/internal/leadflow -> spike around enrichment queue. This is affecting demo requests. Need quick mitigation + weekend coverage plan. @tara_revops @mike_sales

tara_revops: Thanks Anna. Looking into workflows + webhook retries. I see a backlog on HubSpot enrichment webhook retries and some SF mapping failures. I can flip a fallback to put to an overflow owner pool while we clear. @mike_sales ok if overflow takes cold leads for now?

mike_sales: short-term ok, prefer not to touch rotation long-term. how long do you need?

ben_engineering: I can patch the assignment worker to be more tolerant of transient failures (increase claim timeout and retry). Plan: bump claim_timeout 90s -> 150s and enable backoff jitter. Will deploy if you approve.

anna_marketing: Approve the temporary engineering change. Also can we add a PagerDuty rule: fire if unassigned_rate >= 10% for >30m? We missed alerting earlier.

kate_ops: I'll own the runbook+PD rule. Creating ticket INC-3142 and will add weekend on-call rotation for marketing handoffs.

tara_revops: Quick patch applied in HubSpot: changed fallback owner in `Inbound Assignment` workflow to `inbound-overflow` for 2h window. Workflow: `workflow/assign-fallback` (audit id: wf-2026-07-19-88).

ben_engineering: Deploying assignment worker change now. Commands:```bash
# rollout new config
kubectl set env deployment/assigner CLAIM_TIMEOUT=150 BACKOFF_JITTER=0.2
kubectl rollout restart deployment/assigner
```Logs show claims stabilized after restart. Deployed at 2140004300.

deploy-bot: deploy/assigner rollout succeeded (rc=0) — 2140004300

mike_sales: Monitoring metrics — assignment latency dropping, unassigned rate down to 3% in the last 15m. :thumbsup:

anna_marketing: Great work. Next steps: 1) kate_ops to add PD rule + runbook entry (INC-3142) 2) ben to keep temp config for 24h then revert if stable 3) tara to follow up with HubSpot team to root-cause enrichment retries. Assigning: @kate_ops, @ben_engineering, @tara_revops. Please update ticket with postmortem notes.

kate_ops: Added runbook entry under Playbooks -> inbound-routing and added weekend coverage calendar. PD rule created: PD-RULE-assign-01.

tara_revops: I'll dig into why enrichment webhook backlog happened (looks correlated with recent enrichment batch job throttle). Will propose throttling limits + retry windows in a separate PR.

anna_marketing: Closing for now — we'll do a short postmortem sync on Monday marketing ops. If it resurfaces, PD will page. Thanks everyone :heart:
